text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to recommend the installation of a stop control for westbound traffic on Neilor Crescent at the intersection of Neilor Crescent. This intersection is currently uncontrolled and the installation of a stop control will define the right-of-way, enhancing traffic management and safety at this location.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Designated the north-south leg of Neilor Crescent, between Bloor Street West and the south end of the north-south leg of Neilor Crescent, as a through highway.
